name: issue-215-broad-fund-sleeve-trade
description: Issue #215: a held total-market fund (SWTSX → US_TOTAL_MARKET) with a custom cap tilt drifts on a single sleeve (mid-cap overweight). The pre-fix engine pinned a lone US_MID_CAP sell to SWTSX — an unexecutable instruction shown as 'SWTSX · Mid Cap', since selling SWTSX moves large/mid/small together. The fixed engine treats SWTSX as an implicit blended fund: it sells the fund as a unit (a BLENDED_FUND_SOLD disclosure, labeled US Total Market) and buys back the over-sold large/small sleeves via FXAIX/VB, so the executed trades preserve the account net and land every sleeve on target. Fails on the pre-fix engine (no BLENDED_FUND_SOLD flag).
